member.name: T:Ahmodi.ThrottledReconstructionEngine
member.summary: Dynamic traffic-shaping engine that governs background erasure reconstruction operations. Integrates with to prevent background disk rebuilds from saturating storage controllers and starving foreground client I/O. Automatically applies an exact 75% bandwidth reduction (40 MB/s -> 10 MB/s) when telemetry signals disk or node stress.
